Name: Sky Icon
Source: Lyres Guide to Risk and Reward
Information:
**Icons of the Land, Sea & Sky**

Icons of the different terrestrial modes are also known as Greater Icons, and are mostly Large beasts that reside in the terrain of their choosing. They wander the planar wilderness, revered by those who see them and left mostly in peace. Those who find kinship with these creatures often find them protecting their land and families. Agents of the Eidolons have been known to approach these icons and request their service as companions in battle or as mounts.

***Attack Methods.*** The stat block for these icons lists several attack options assuming the icon takes the form of an animal resembling a lion (land), small whale/shark (sea) or large bird (sky), but it may have various different methods of attack, including Bite, Gore, Slam, Hoof, etc. Depending on their form they may not have all of these attack options. You can change the attacks used as part of their multiattack if you wish to, changing the damage types to suit the method of attack you may want.

traits.name: Telempathetic Discouragement
traits.description: When a creature targets the icon with an attack or effect intended to cause harm to it while within range of its telepathy, the attacker must succeed on a DC 14 Charisma saving throw or be charmed for 1 minute. A creature charmed this way shares the icon’s feelings, becoming discouraged from violence and (though the icon holds no direct sway over their actions) they must contend with their guilt before harming it. A creature that fails can repeat the saving throw at the start of each of their turns and each time they take damage, ending the effect on a successful save. A creature that succeeds any save against this effect becomes immune to it and the Telempathetic Discouragement of any icon with a CR of 7 or lower for 24 hours.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.description: The icon attacks twice with its Talons or twice with its Feather Arrows.

actions.name: Talons
actions.description: Melee Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, reach 5 ft., one target. Hit: 13 (2d8 + 4) piercing damage plus 9 (2d8) radiant damage.

actions.name: Feather Arrows
actions.description: Ranged Weapon Attack: +7 to hit, range 60/180 ft., one target. Hit: 10 (1d10 + 4) piercing damage plus 6 (1d10) radiant damage.

actions.name: Convictive Bolts (Recharge 6)
actions.description: The icon targets up to three creatures it can see within 120 feet of it, and fires an arrow-like bolt of radiant force at each. These targets must succeed on a DC 15 Dexterity saving throw, taking 17 (3d10) radiant damage and 20 (3d12) force damage on a failed save, or half as much on a successful one. Each creature that fails by 5 points or more is also stunned until the end of their next turn.

actions.name: Teleport
actions.description: The icon, its equipment, and any creature riding it teleport up to 60 feet away, reappearing in an unoccupied space it can see.

bonus_actions.name: Illuminate
bonus_actions.description: The icon causes its body to glow as though by the daylight spell, granting soft light of a color it chooses in a radius centered on it, which can range from 5 to 60 feet, with another sphere of dim light extending twice as far. The icon can use this action again to adjust or dispel this light.
